Class WaitingRoomAfterCrashStateTest

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.gameLogic.WaitingRoomAfterCrashStateTest
public class WaitingRoomAfterCrashStateTest extends Object

Test class for WaitingRoomAfterCrashState. This class tests the behavior of the game state after a server crash, where players need to reconnect.
